problem: GenesisScene mounts the 3D cosmic world (three WebGL canvases) at the entry route. In the cloud VM the renderer is software, the scene keeps painting at a device-limited rate, and the CDP automation connection time-stalls before a conversation can be driven.

measured_before.cdp: browserType.connectOverCDP timed out at 10 s twice during the first attempt; a click on the sign-in gate hung after scrolling into view

mechanism.name: ?scene=off (development only)
mechanism.applied_in: GenesisScene.tsx → GenesisWorkspaceRouter, the same branch that already renders no scene when chat owns a phone screen
mechanism.production: IS_DEV is inlined false in a production build, so the flag cannot be reached by a link; an automated test asserts sceneDisabledBySearch('?scene=off', false) === false
what_remains_real: GenesisChat / Chat Universe and its composers
the provider path through the same-origin /api/model broker and Groq
the memory, cognition and agent bridges
mechanism.what_is_disabled: only the visual workspace beneath the interface: the WebGL canvases, the 3D controller, the sky backdrop and the phase HUD that live inside GenesisV1Workspace
mechanism.not_mocked: no store, no memory path, no provider, no chat behaviour and no authorization check is replaced

limitation: The screenshot of the sign-in gate was taken before the flag existed and before an account was created; the acceptance run continued without an account, so no identity is claimed beyond an anonymous browser session.
